resources.string: Choose up to four apps in order. The last app stays in front. Tap Run to open the sequence.
This space is yours. Hold an app in the index to place it here.
Invisible camera control while idle. A small capsule during playback, with details on tap. Enable control and calibrate first.

Android grants media-session access through notification access. This is a broad system permission. Intelia uses playback metadata and controls; it does not read, save or send message notifications. You can revoke access in Android Settings.
Hold for your apps and FLOW
The sequence could not be completed. An earlier app may already be open.
Camera calibration could not be opened.

Pulse uses a small overlay around the camera and window package changes to hide controls over system screens. It does not read app content, take screenshots or automate gestures. Media access is optional and separate. You can disable Pulse at any time.

Align the inner oval with your camera. The faint outer frame is the touch area; its padding is independent. Nothing is shown here during normal idle use. Choose Done to save. LENS remains a larger accessible alternative.
Enable Intelia Pulse in Accessibility to see the preview around your camera.
